scope: Read-only review of existing local preview-v3 files. Only this scratch report was written. No canonical files, auth, rendering or network actions.
method: Viewed the 960px-wide phone contact sheet as nine 320x180 thumbnail tiles.
Independently viewed JA, TH and ES 1280x720 JPEGs; this is the full-size sample, not a claim that all nine full-size images were inspected in this turn.
Compared all nine generated HTML headline/sub/tag strings with current intended words and the earlier accepted wording recommendations.
Verified all nine artifact and HTML SHA256 values against result.json.
Read existing native QA estimates from result.json; did not independently rerun a browser or measure the text height.
observations: All nine headline subject/hook combinations remain on one line with no visible clipping in phone tiles. The ring is clearly visible and its hole remains visible above the headline.
JA particles and question mark are complete. TH upper/lower marks and its sub are complete in the full-size view. ES opening/closing question marks and its long series label are complete.

The series label and highlighted hook appear orange. All nine generated HTML files set --ai-accent:#ff8a1f and bind the series b element to that accent; JPEG color compression is not treated as exact pixel-level color proof.
The white sub has clear contrast on the dark lower background, and each locale preserves the original/self-made and not-Kimi distinction.

The native QA reported headline estimates span 26–33px at a 320px width, with no layout problems or warnings. These estimates are separate from the visual assessment; the 24px threshold was not modified.
render_boundary: The existing preflight states that FIT/theme changed and normal_fresh_render_required is true. This thumbnail preview PASS does not approve old FIT1 body raster reuse or claim that the separate 110-scene normal fresh render and assembly has completed.
